metadata.invariant: missing != zero; heuristic != proof; provenance precedes promotion

operational_arms.label: Catalogação e identidade
operational_arms.function: Identificar entidades, arquivos, claims, tokens e versões.

operational_arms.label: Contexto e autoridade
operational_arms.function: Fixar língua, domínio, escala, época, sinônimos e escopo.

operational_arms.label: Proveniência e custódia
operational_arms.function: Ligar fonte, caminho, commit, dataset, run e hash.

operational_arms.label: Evidência e oposição
operational_arms.function: Separar evidência externa, local, replicada, falsificador e controle negativo.

operational_arms.label: Operadores e transformações
operational_arms.function: Aplicar direta, inversa, indireta, reversiva, derivada, antiderivada e escalas logarítmicas.

operational_arms.label: Vazios e anomalias
operational_arms.function: Classificar desconhecido, não medido, contraditório, ignorado, abortado, retido e irrecuperável.

operational_arms.label: Risco e governança
operational_arms.function: Aplicar finalidade, acesso, privacidade, rollback, quarentena e revisão humana.

operational_arms.label: Retroalimentação e próximo gate
operational_arms.function: Registrar delta, resultado negativo, aprendizado e próxima ação verificável.

gap_classes.label: Origem, autoria ou cadeia de custódia ausente
Fronteira, escala, eixo ou condição de contorno ausente
Critério de saída de ciclo ausente
Informação retida, censurada ou inacessível sem prova suficiente

dynamics.label: Trajetórias paralelas
dynamics.invariant: methodological bridge is not physical equivalence

anomaly_classes.label: acesso, finalidade ou decisão não auditável

records.label: Ontologia Operacional RAFAELIA
records.definition: Catálogo versionado de entidades, claims, tokens, relações, operadores, vazios e próximos gates.
records.next_gate: Validate the ontology with the stdlib engine.

records.label: Inventário biblioteconômico da sessão
records.definition: Inventário de estruturas, tokens, operadores, dinâmicas, anomalias, paradoxos, utopias e lacunas discutidos e materializados.
records.next_gate: Map every listed element to a repository path or TOKEN_VAZIO provenance record.

records.label: DAG causal executável
records.definition: DAG that separates observed association, mechanism, confounders, interventions and falsifiers.
records.reason: No executable causal DAG engine is registered in this ontology.
records.decision_context: Natural next step from the session inventory.
falsifiers: engine cannot distinguish association from intervention
records.next_gate: Define DAG schema and negative-control fixtures.

records.label: Calibração de pesos operacionais
records.context: coherence, evidence, stability and risk weights
records.definition: Weights used to rank candidate trajectories without choosing values to favor a desired conclusion.
records.reason: No blocked benchmark or ground truth exists.
records.decision_context: Weights must be learned or pre-registered, not invented.
falsifiers: weights fail outside the calibration set
records.next_gate: Create blinded benchmark and baseline models.

records.label: Bootstrap e propagação de incerteza
records.definition: Resampling and error propagation for derivatives, model comparison and heuristic scores.
records.reason: No canonical implementation or frozen fixture is linked.
records.next_gate: Implement deterministic bootstrap fixture with fixed seed.

records.label: Condições de contorno das antiderivadas
records.definition: Contract that declares integration constants, origin boundaries and reconstruction assumptions.
records.reason: The operator was described, but a canonical boundary contract was not implemented.
falsifiers: different admissible boundaries yield incompatible conclusions
records.next_gate: Define boundary-condition schema and ambiguity report.

relations.scope: recover session origin from current catalog
relations.boundary_condition: conversation timestamp and cited repository commit

records.label: Competição de modelos log-log
records.definition: Protocol that treats a straight log-log plot as a candidate and compares it with alternative distributions.
records.reason: No canonical out-of-sample model-comparison fixture exists.
records.decision_context: Needed to prevent visual power-law overclaim.
falsifiers: alternative model has superior blocked predictive score
records.next_gate: Freeze synthetic and real fixtures for model comparison.

records.label: Independência automática das fontes
records.definition: Deduplication and lineage analysis that prevents dependent sources from being counted as independent replications.
records.reason: Lineage identifiers are not complete across repositories.
records.decision_context: High-leverage gap for bibliographic and experimental auditability.
falsifiers: known shared dataset is counted as independent
records.next_gate: Define lineage_id authority and deduplication rules.

records.label: Corpus vetorial integral reconstruído
records.context: large private vector corpus divided into chunks
records.definition: Ordered, hashed and re-composable vector corpus preserving rare bridges and validity masks.
records.reason: The complete corpus is not present in the current repository checkout and may contain private data.
records.decision_context: Access-controlled; non-availability is not classified as censorship.
falsifiers: chunk order or hash chain cannot reconstruct the declared corpus
records.next_gate: Create authorized chunk manifest without exposing private content.

records.label: Validação humana de semântica e compreensão
records.definition: Ethically reviewed study comparing token-level metrics with human comprehension and contextual meaning.
records.reason: No ethics-approved protocol, consent flow or participant dataset exists.
records.decision_context: Aborted as an executable study until ethics, privacy and risk controls exist.
falsifiers: metrics fail to predict blinded comprehension outcomes
records.next_gate: Keep closed until independent ethics and privacy review authorizes a protocol.

records.label: Dimensão fractal física da cognição
records.definition: Claim that a measured physical cognitive process has a validated fractal dimension under a declared estimator and scale range.
records.reason: No estimator, scale range, null model or replicated measurement is registered.
records.decision_context: Preserved as a frontier hypothesis rather than promoted from metaphor.
falsifiers: estimated scaling disappears under surrogate data or alternative estimator
records.next_gate: Define estimator, surrogate null and pre-registered scale interval.

records.label: Validação externa e replicação independente
records.definition: Independent reproduction using separated lineage, environment and blocked acceptance criteria.
records.reason: No independent run or third-party evidence is linked.
records.decision_context: Final promotion gate for frontier-science claims.
falsifiers: independent run does not reproduce the pre-registered effect
records.next_gate: Publish a reproduction bundle with frozen inputs and acceptance criteria.

relations.scope: reconstruct claim lineage from replication bundle
relations.reconstruction_metric: all source pointers and hashes resolved
